=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12141-12143 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Both mktemp calls run before the EXIT trap is registered, so a failure of the second mktemp can orphan the first temp file and leave the gate without the intended cleanup path.
  WHY: The first file has no cleanup handler yet, and reviewers noted the setup can fail before later verifier/log handling has a valid temp path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12141-12161 | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The gate only special-cases verifier exit codes 1 and 2, so any other non-zero exit, including signal deaths like 137 or 143, falls through as a clean pass.
  WHY: That lets OOM-killed or externally terminated verifier runs advance dispatch on potentially broken integration state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12164 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: trap - EXIT clears any existing EXIT trap globally, not just the gate-scoped one.
  WHY: A prior or future cleanup handler elsewhere in the script could be silently removed when this block runs.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:680-692 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The argument parser breaks on the first unrecognized token and treats it as the positional fingerprint path instead of rejecting it.
  WHY: A typo or future flag addition then fails later as a file-open/plumbing error rather than with a clear unknown-flag error.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:Wave-dispatch gate blocked path, lines around the jq increment after WAVE_GATE_BLOCKED=true | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: When the wave gate blocks, the code increments judge_cycle and judge_stall_cycles but does not increment unresolved_ticks.
  WHY: Repeated gate violations can be misrouted into stall-recovery instead of escalating to the judge path.
